newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were slightly higher across the board on Monday, traders said.
A dealer said the increase in rates could have been prompted by more peso borrowings encouraged by the low swap rates at the PHIBOR market.
Banks may be taking advantage of the low rates before these move up again, the dealer said, adding that some banks which have not been active in PHIBOR had started quoting rates.
"It's still cheaper to borrow via the swaps rather than the interbank market," the dealer added.
